subject: Forecast categories: new Commit/Best Case guidance + rollout training
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Sales Team <sales@redwood.ai>, Joanna Park <joanna@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast categories: new Commit/Best Case guidance + rollout training

Hi team and Joanna,

Quick heads-up — finance and sales ops have finalized a small but important update to our forecast category definitions (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline). The goal: reduce ambiguity on what should count in Commit vs Best Case so our monthly numbers are both actionable and auditable. This will affect how we count revenue for the July close and going forward.

Key definitions (summary):
- Commit: Legally obligating commercial agreement executed or customer PO/POA received AND an agreed implementation/start date within the next 30 days. No subjective confidence language.
- Best Case: High-probability opportunities where terms are agreed but no signed instrument or PO exists; or signed instrument exists but start/implementation window >30 days.
- Pipeline: Early-stage, discovery, proof-of-concept (POC) opportunities without commercial terms agreed.

Timeline & asks:
- Effective date: new definitions take effect Monday, 2026-07-27 for weekly forecast submissions.
- Please review and update your open deals in HubSpot by EOD Friday, 2026-07-24. Focus on deals with close dates in Aug–Oct.
- We’re running two mandatory training slots and smaller role-play breakouts (see attached):
  * Wed 2026-07-21 10:00–11:00 PT — Definitions + runbook walk-through
  * Thu 2026-07-22 15:00–16:30 PT — Deal-level calibration + role-play sessions
  Use the calendar links below to pick one slot; role-play groups will be assigned based on territory.

Attachments: forecast_commit_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook, examples, QA checklist), playbook-exercises.xlsx (sample deals for calibration).

Why this matters: we want predictable, audit-ready commits that finance can forecast for cash planning while preserving growth signals in Best Case. If you have edge cases (large enterprise amendments, multi-PO deals, procurement delays) please flag them early — we’ll have a brief exceptions process documented in the runbook.

Joanna — looping you so Acme can confirm the timeline if this impacts the ACME-98234 close plan.

Thanks,

Team — quick directive: this is mandatory for all quota-carrying reps. No more subjective Commit entries. If you rely on verbal commitment only, move the deal to Best Case until a PO or signed contract is in-hand. We will run a weekly calibration every Monday for the next four weeks to reconcile exceptions.

Thanks all — calendar invites sent for the two sessions. I’ve attached the role-play instructions for the breakouts and a short checklist to use during deal reviews. Please RSVP if you haven’t already.

For quick clarifications raised in the inbox:
- ACME-98234 (Monica flagged): if procurement confirms an imminent PO that will be received before 7/27, you may leave as Commit but attach the procurement email/PO in HubSpot and add a one-line rationale. If procurement is still working through terms, move to Best Case.
- Large multi-PO renewals: treat each PO as a separate revenue event; mark Commit only when PO for the specific revenue period is in-hand.

See you in the sessions — please bring one recent deal to practice on.
